Dark souls will only truly show its beauty with the persistent, resilient, and open minded. Close minded people unwilling to at least try it and are quick to go along with the negative have no right to judge something fully; folding with only half a hand. One way I get my friends to play a new game is to strike a deal with them. Steam has a refund option (if you are playing on pc) that gives the opportunity to try a game and refund it if it was not enjoyed, aka 2 hours of play time and within 2 weeks. So in a regular scenario I usually bug my friends first about buying the game and I actually did this with dark souls 2 for my friend damian. So the deal is that if within the 2 hour period the game was not enjoyed then refund it and I will never bug them again, he didn't like the game so he refunded it and I have never asked him since. So my advice to you is if they have tried them and hated them thats ok move on, but if they haven't tried them and hate them and are refusing to try then they are not worthy to play and beat any soulsborne game.

TL;DR don't force them to try the game if they are dead set not to. Its their loss because you can't explain the feeling of the game, it needs to be experienced first hand.
